entities.summary: Royal marriages were treaties in human form. Children were betrothed as infants to seal alliances. The Habsburgs married their way to control of Europe ("Let others wage war; thou, happy Austria, marry"). Catherine de' Medici, Eleanor of Aquitaine, and countless princesses were diplomatic currency.
